public_body: Sudbury Goodnow Library Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found the Goodnow Library Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a posted meeting when the Chair's statement was emailed to the full Board; no other deliberation was found.

allegations.summary: Board deliberated about the library's relationship with the Friends outside a posted meeting, including by email before the January 19 meeting.
Other communications among Board members and staff about the Friends relationship, beyond the circulated statement, were alleged to be deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: these communications did not involve a quorum of the Board and therefore did not constitute impermissible deliberation.

allegations.summary: The complaint raised other concerns beyond the Open Meeting Law allegations, which the AG said were outside the scope of its review.
allegations.key_passage: Our review is limited to allegations raised in the original Open Meeting Law complaint and which allege violations of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (no additional remedial action, since the statement was read aloud in full at the open January 19 meeting).
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
